gbroCollageBroll.policy: Preserve the three-gate approval protocol, the editorial halftone paper-collage visual system, the prompt structure, and the QA standards. Replace the execution layer with VidMuse model serve through vidmuse-cli.

patches.vidmuse-vox: Replaced the upstream fixed 5-second clip with narration-driven duration: resolve voice and word timing first, split the script into arguments rather than sentences, and generate one clip per argument at a duration covering its measured narration span, phasing assembly across long spans. Added a mandatory voice spine using minimax/speech-2.6-hd for narration and doubao_speech/audio_text_alignment for word timing, both executed through vidmuse-media, because timing is the source of the duration plan; clips remain silent with narration carried separately. Repointed still generation from the Codex built-in image_gen tool to gpt-image-2, removing the upstream host-environment dependency. Repointed video generation from a direct gemini-omni-flash-preview API call to minimax/hailuo-h3 with seedance-2.0-pro as fallback, both taking a two-image first/last-frame request, defaulting to 720p. Added a budget phase between the beat plan and the first gate, because the upstream skill has no cost model: the film is costed from live catalog prices against the real credit balance plus a retry reserve, and a short balance yields an affordable subset with a stated shortfall rather than a refusal or a silently shrunken film, with beats dropped whole rather than shortened below their narration spans. Added local output normalization before QA, because the provider does not reliably honor the requested resolution or duration: each clip is scaled, frame-rate locked, and trimmed to exactly target_duration_s x 24 frames from a read-only raw.mp4, with surplus tail frames cut rather than short clips padded by a freeze, and provenance records the returned spec beside the requested one plus the single variable each retry changed. Required an explicit generation_type on image, video, and voice model calls, and an explicitly cast voice_id resolved from voice list model_ids, because the voice models report empty required_params yet still reject a request that omits either, returning an opaque Aion 400 that names no field. Trimmed the animation prompt's negatives to shot discipline only, dropping artifact-suppression negatives that current video models do not need and that can introduce the very content they name. Dropped GEMINI_API_KEY, the shared .omni-venv virtualenv, the google-genai dependency, check_setup.sh, generate_video.py, upload_file.py, and the legacy Veo script. Added result fetching, local verification, and per-beat provenance.json because VidMuse model runs return public URLs. Aligned artifacts to videos/<project>/.

vidmuseShotcraft.policy: Ship all 162 canonical HyperFrames Registry blocks in-tree. Discover by an approved communicative job, install exact shot-* names through the local installer, isolate project assets per block, replace every demonstration surface before publishing, and never mount a raw Registry item in VidMuse Timeline.

integration.create: Full vocabulary after story, evidence, FRAME.md, beat duration, and cue chain are settled.
integration.recut: Fail-closed policy: recut:safe first, recut:adapt only with structural review, and unlabeled blocks remain create-only.
integration.officialRegistry: The remote HyperFrames Registry remains configured for upstream items; Shotcraft is installed from the plugin filesystem.

vidmuseShotcraft.adaptations: Added bilingual job indexes, a separately maintained recut policy, deterministic catalog and integrity checks, an offline local installer with item-namespaced assets and overwrite protection, project lock receipts, and VidMuse create/recut policy gates. The 162 motion payloads themselves remain the canonical pilot Registry versions.

hyperframes.policy: Pinned upstream domain skills with minimal VidMuse policy patches: no HyperFrames Studio/timeline UI and no HyperFrames-managed AI/media model selection or downloads.

vidmuse-design-frame-presets.contents: The complete official set of FRAME.md templates, caption skins, showcase HTML, and preset-local fonts.
vidmuse-design-frame-presets.policy: Keep as an optional user-visible gallery, inactive by default. VidMuse independently authors FRAME.md from the content and source unless the user explicitly selects a preset; then source analysis, human-presence rules, protected regions, and the approved project FRAME.md govern adaptation.

vidmuse-recut.policy: Preserve official styles, layouts, frames, fonts, GSAP asset, Storyboard v3, card HTML, composition, and media contract. Replace HyperFrames model-backed transcription and Studio review with VidMuse adapters, and override only the official card-count and placement heuristics with VidMuse content direction and visual-occupancy safety rules.

patches.hyperframes-core: Preserved the composition and planning contracts; replaced Studio review with snapshot review and routed media models to VidMuse.
patches.hyperframes-cli: Preserved unrelated CLI capabilities; removed Studio/timeline entry points and HyperFrames model-backed media preprocessing.
patches.hyperframes-animation: Kept deterministic animation knowledge; routed transcript timings to VidMuse media and cross-linked installable Shotcraft transition blocks without merging catalogs.
patches.hyperframes-keyframes: Unmodified; its timelines and models refer to animation/3D mechanics, not UI or AI models.
patches.hyperframes-registry: Preserved discovery, installation, wiring, templates, and contribution guidance; replaced preview validation with snapshots and cross-linked VidMuse's separate filesystem Shotcraft Registry.

excluded.hyperframes-creative: The workflow skill remains excluded because vidmuse-design owns visual direction; its official frame-presets are vendored as a pinned resource subset.
excluded.creation-workflows: vidmuse-create and vidmuse-recut own film workflows.
